title: Application of CARE-SD text classifier tools to assess distribution of stigmatizing and doubt-marking language features in EHR
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying stigmatizing language and doubt markers (linguistic features of bias) in clinical notes as a socio-clinical phenomenon. While it uses the term 'epistemology' in a linguistic context (referring to evidentials), it does not address religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems, and it does not benchmark these values in the models themselves.
